title: Compare four search result forms
description: You can observe the same successful and missing searches through four supplied interfaces.

steps.description: The first search returns an index or None. The second returns an index or raises ValueError.
find_tuple returns an index with a Boolean flag. find_result returns a string tag paired with an index or NotFoundError record.

steps.question: Which supplied target is found at index 2?

steps.description: The caller displays the sentinel, handles the exception, and unpacks the tuple. The missing search produces None, a ValueError, or (-1, False), respectively.
The final caller branches on the string tag and formats Ok or Err text. These labels describe ordinary tuple results in this Python implementation.
